## Instruction Slide

### Description
The Instruction Slide creates a simple 2 column layout with an image on the left and a list of bullet points on the right e.g:

![example image](../images/instruction-slide-example.png)

### Basic Usage
```ts
// simple use requires only the texture for the image and the strings to go on the right
const imageTexture: PIXI.Texture = AssetManager.getTextureResourceData('htp-screen-2');
const strings: INewHowToPlaySlideStrings = container.strings.howToPlay.slides[1];
// but a config can be passed as the 3rd parameter if desired, more on this below
const config: IInstructionsSlideConfig = {};

const htpSlide = new InstructionSlide(imageTexture, strings, config }); // config can be omitted if empty
```

#### Config
A config can be passed when creating a slide to adjust it's layout and appearance.
```ts
export interface IInstructionSlideConfig {
    fontStyles?: {
        default?: Partial<ITextStyle>,
        bullet?: Partial<ITextStyle>,
        title?: Partial<ITextStyle>
    },
    imageWidth?: number, // reducing this increases the space for the text and vice versa
    textPadding?: {
        left: number;
        top: number;
        right: number;
    },
    titleIcon?: { // used to display an image to the right of the title (see the white squre in the image above)
        texture: Texture,
        width: number
    }
}
```
